title: Advanced Treatise on the Qi-Cut Sickle
summary: Advances students from plain hooking to armor-tearing cuts carried on full meridian qi, with counters for each.

title: Canon of the Field-Wide Qi Hook
summary: Extends the sickle's reach through a living qi field so hooks and sweeps cover a whole field of fighters.

title: Book of Armor Gaps and the Biting Curve
summary: Teaches the curved tip to find seams, straps and joints in armor and tear them open.

title: Advanced Studies in Hooked Disarmament
summary: Studies how to catch, bind and strip weapons from armed opponents with the hook, including spear and sword.

title: Twin-Row Studies of the Paired Sickle
summary: Teaches fighting with a sickle in each hand, the two blades crossing, guarding and hooking as one pair.

title: The Hawk-Talon Curve and the Azure Row
summary: Casts the sickle's curve as a hawk's talon, diving, seizing and lifting an opponent with field-borne qi.

title: Basin Harvest Court Treatise on the Hook
summary: Sets the hook and sweep in the flowing rhythm of basin harvest work for students of Ruler standing.

title: Wind-Sworn Reading of the Plateau Sickle
summary: Reads the sickle's cuts and hooks as wind motions sworn to the plateau, favoring open ground and long sweeps.

title: Bearing Lessons for the Edge-Walking Sickle
summary: Teaches fighting on cliff rims and narrow paths by taking and holding a bearing against the crosswind.

title: The Wind-Sworn Hook Swept Before the Squall
summary: Uses oncoming wind to push cuts and hooks harder, pressing an opponent back across open plain.
